ruleDefinitions.name: VMToolsd Suspicious Child Process
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious child process creations of VMware Tools process which may indicate persistence setup

sequences.query: (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\vmtoolsd\\\.exe$") AND ((process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cscript\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\mshta\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\regsvr32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wscript\\\.exe$")) OR (process_original_file_name = "Cmd\.Exe" OR process_original_file_name = "cscript\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "MSHTA\.EXE" OR process_original_file_name = "PowerShell\.EXE" OR process_original_file_name = "pwsh\.dll" OR process_original_file_name = "REGSVR32\.EXE" OR process_original_file_name = "RUNDLL32\.EXE" OR process_original_file_name = "wscript\.exe"))) AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\VMware\\\\VMware\\ Tools\\\\poweron\\-vm\\-default\\\.bat.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\VMware\\\\VMware\\ Tools\\\\poweroff\\-vm\\-default\\\.bat.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\VMware\\\\VMware\\ Tools\\\\resume\\-vm\\-default\\\.bat.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\VMware\\\\VMware\\ Tools\\\\suspend\\-vm\\-default\\\.bat.*"))) OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") AND process_command_line = "") OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") AND process_command_line = "None"))
